rbl-export.reason: Read-only typed inspection, stale-plan validation and conflict evidence.
The AudioConverter a caller converts tracks with on the way to the stick.
Converter selection, recorded conversions, reuse on a second sync, and turning conversion off.
Decision, recovery, schema, integrity and stale-token regression coverage.

crates/rbl-core/Cargo.toml.reason: Depend on the extracted model and storage packages rather than mixing their implementations in core.

crates/rbl-core/src/lib.rs.reason: Re-export rb-model primitives and rb-storage durability for existing engine/codec callers.

crates/rbl-core/src/mpeg.rs.reason: Read an MP3's encoder delay from its LAME or ffmpeg tag and combine it with the frame lead into a content start, for rb-audio.

crates/rbl-core/src/durable.rs.reason: Relocated to rb-storage; root_fingerprint binds reviews to a mounted filesystem root using stable Windows handle information, with directory rename and path-reuse regression coverage. Tests use writable timestamp handles and portable injected error kinds while retaining platform-specific unsupported-error checks.

crates/rbl-db/src/dropbox.rs.reason: Tests use drive-qualified Dropbox folders on Windows, where a rooted path without a drive is not absolute.

crates/rbl-db/src/itunes.rs.reason: Tests compare candidate library files as paths so Windows separators match.

crates/rbl-db/src/locate.rs.reason: Tests expect masterDbDirectory with forward slashes on Windows, as it is written there, and name the unused library with one separator style.

crates/rbl-db/src/track_path.rs.reason: Tests compare resolved cloud paths as paths so Windows separators from Path::join match.

crates/rbl-db/tests/cloud_paths.rs.reason: Compare the resolved cloud path as a path so Windows separators from Path::join match.

crates/rbl-db/tests/new_library.rs.reason: Compare masterDbDirectory as a path, as it is written with forward slashes on Windows.

crates/rbl-db/tests/writes.rs.reason: Find imported rows by folder with either separator, as FolderPath keeps Windows backslashes.

crates/rbl-index/tests/cloud_local_copy..reason: Compare the resolved Dropbox copy as a path so Windows separators from Path::join match.

crates/rbl-export/Cargo.toml.reason: Add the pure conflict contract dependency.

crates/rbl-export/src/lib.rs.reason: Preserve Export Studio namespaces, remove automatic settings discovery, add typed review checks, decision receipts, schema v3 and explicit recovery. Windows error codes for removed media, and a cache folder under a file bypasses the cache there too. Verification includes preserved tracks. A caller's AudioConverter converts tracks it wants, moves their cues and analysis by its offset, describes its output in both databases and is reused from the manifest; plan summaries count copies, conversions and removals.

crates/rbl-export/src/manifest.rs.reason: Version 3 stores accepted review decisions with the recoverable generation. Tracks record what a caller's converter made of them.

crates/rbl-export/src/plan.rs.reason: Estimates include a caller's converter; plan summaries count copies, conversions, kept tracks and removals, and say when the stick is up to date.

crates/rbl-export/src/estimate.rs.reason: Tracks a caller's converter wants count as conversions, sized by its estimate, and are reused only with a recorded conversion.

crates/rbl-export/src/incremental.rs.reason: The request digest includes a caller's converter profile, and is unchanged without one.

crates/rbl-export/src/snapshot.rs.reason: Produce typed review evidence and bypass device-edit checks only for validated conflict IDs.

crates/rbl-export/tests/device_playlist_.reason: Assert typed review-required decisions while preserving the existing device-addition reconciliation behavior.

crates/rbl-export/tests/player_cue_edits.reason: Assert unresolved cue-loss review blocks before copying and explicit discard permits removal.

crates/rbl-export/tests/ratings.rs.reason: Assert typed metadata review and no-write behavior for an unrelated device comment.

crates/rbl-export/tests/rekordbox_stick..reason: Assert typed cross-format blockers for retained unowned track differences.

crates/rbl-export/tests/safety.rs.reason: Assert typed review leaves device-only tags and cue rows preserved.

crates/rbl-export/tests/stick_only_playl.reason: Assert typed non-overridable blockers for cross-format playlist divergence.

crates/rbl-devices/tests/inspect.rs.reason: Update the helper fixture to the schema-v3 inspect/export protocol.

crates/rbl-devices/src/lib.rs.reason: Split the fake volume list as PATH is, so Windows drive letters survive.

crates/rbl-export/tests/on_stick.rs.reason: Skip the trailing-dot folder case on Windows, which cannot make such a folder.

localExtractions.rb-library: native/crates/es-db: guarded master.db implementation; profiling removed and discovery separated.
localExtractions.rb-device: native/crates/es-device: volume and USB read API; tests now import rb_device.
localExtractions.rb-anlz: native/crates/es-anlz: analysis-file API with additional cross-parser coverage.
localExtractions.rb-model/source: native/crates/es-usb: source records without the helper's protocol envelope.
localExtractions.rb-usb/prepare: native/crates/es-usb: private cue, track and playlist conversion logic.

downstreamChanges: Keep .exportstudio-publication journal and exportstudio manifest/recovery paths in rbl-export sources and fixtures.
Move all imported crates and upstream test-support crates into native; pin their versions explicitly to 1.9.0 while application crates remain 0.1.0.
Inherit dependency/lint settings from native/Cargo.toml, retaining thin-LTO releases and the native test profile.
es-usb is a thin schema-v3 inspect/export JSON transport over rb-model source records and the rb-usb service.
Phase 3 extracts model/storage and generic library/device/analysis/USB packages; compatibility crates/re-exports keep existing app and upstream callers working.
Phase 4 adds typed conflict evidence, allowed resolutions, stale-plan tokens and journal-coupled decision receipts; only the recorded safe actions are supported.
